description: Evaluations for game-product-designer skill v3.0 (with GDP). Each eval tests the full pipeline from a one-line idea to a structured GDD with experience design intent and design risk flags.

assertions_schema.has-genre-analysis: GDD contains genre tag hierarchy + at least 3 reference product analysis with WHY mechanics work, not just WHAT they are
assertions_schema.has-core-loop: GDD defines 30s loop (Stimulus→Decision→Action→Feedback) AND 5min session loop (entry→core→exit→hook)
assertions_schema.has-system-decomposition: GDD decomposes game into named modules with responsibilities, each mapping to a loop role or genre mechanic
assertions_schema.has-mvp-boundary: GDD explicitly separates P0+P1 (MVP) from P2/P3 with justification for each deferral, plus MVP success criteria
assertions_schema.has-dependency-map: GDD includes module dependency map (layered or matrix) with critical path and recommended build order
assertions_schema.has-assumptions-with-verification: GDD Appendix A lists numbered assumptions with source phase, reasoning, AND verification method (GDP-005)
assertions_schema.has-platform-analysis: GDD Chapter 1.4 includes confirmed platform choice, input method, session length expectation, distribution constraints
assertions_schema.has-tech-stack-direction: GDD Chapter 1.4 includes 2-3 candidate tech stacks with tradeoffs, based on platform choice
assertions_schema.has-experience-design-intent: Every P0/P1 module card in Chapter 4 includes Experience Design Intent: core decisions (1-3), satisfaction moments (1-2), strategy space (GDP-006)
assertions_schema.has-gdp-risk-flags: GDD Appendix C exists with Design Risk Flags table (may be empty if all GDP checks passed)
assertions_schema.no-implementation-code: GDD contains zero function bodies, class implementations, or compilable code; formulas expressed as prose

evals.name: pokemon-like-rpg
evals.source: Real user request from production conversation (2026-04-04)
evals.prompt: 制作一个类似宝可梦的rpg冒险类的游戏
evals.context: User provides only a one-line idea with no platform or differentiation info. Skill should trigger ASK_USER gate to collect platform and differentiation before proceeding.

expected_behavior.ask_user_gate: Skill must ask user about target platform and differentiation before starting pipeline. Must NOT proceed without at least platform confirmation.
expected_behavior.pipeline_phases: Phase 0 (genre analysis) → Phase 1 (core loops with GDP-002/003 checks) → Phase 2 (system decomposition with GDP-001/004/006 checks) → Phase 3 (GDD assembly with GDP sweep)

evals.expected_output: A complete GDD containing: genre analysis (monster collection RPG with reference to Pokemon/Temtem/Nexomon), core loop design (30s combat/capture loop + 5min exploration session) with GDP-002 independence check, system decomposition with MVP experience loop verification (GDP-001), each MVP module card with Experience Design Intent (GDP-006), platform & tech direction, differentiation declaration (GDP-004), assumptions with verification methods (GDP-005), and GDP risk flags appendix.
evals.passing_score: 11/11 with skill, baseline expected ≤4/11 without skill

evals.name: sanguo-card-roguelike
evals.source: Real user project from production conversation (2026-04-04). User's actual game project '三国·命牌' — the scenario that motivated building this entire toolbox.
evals.prompt: 我想做一个三国题材的卡牌roguelike游戏，核心玩法是收集武将牌组成阵法，在roguelike地牢中战斗
evals.context: User provides a moderately detailed idea with theme, core mechanic (cards + formations), and mode (roguelike dungeon). No platform specified — Skill should ask. This is the 'golden path' scenario because it has a clear genre (roguelike deckbuilder) plus a unique differentiator (formation spatial mechanics).

expected_behavior.ask_user_gate: Skill must ask about platform. Differentiation question should reference existing competitors like Slay the Spire, 月圆之夜, or 三国杀.

evals.expected_output: A GDD for a Three Kingdoms card roguelike with: genre analysis referencing Slay the Spire, 月圆之夜, 三国杀, TFT/自走棋; core loops with GDP-002 check (card play decision loop must be fun without meta-progression); system decomposition including card system, formation/synergy system, roguelike run system, dungeon/map system as MVP; each MVP module with Experience Design Intent (GDP-006); differentiation declaration for formation mechanics passing GDP-004 three-criteria test; assumptions with verification (GDP-005); and GDP risk flags appendix. The Three Kingdoms IP must be reflected in gameplay mechanics, not just cosmetic skin.
evals.passing_score: 11/11 with skill, baseline expected ≤4/11 without skill
